prompts.shared_answer_rules:
You MUST read at least one page before answering.
Base your answer ONLY on content from pages you have read.
If evidence is insufficient, answer with text explaining what you could not confirm, and list the page IDs of the pages you did read as sources.
Sources must be the exact page IDs shown in [square brackets] in the search/read results. Never use titles, paths, filenames, or source document IDs.
prompts.tool_difference: Full includes follow_links; No-Links removes its prompt line and rejects it at the action guard.

scoring.rule: answer_correct = for every group in answer_keyword_groups, at least one keyword appears in the normalized answer. For unanswerable cases, answer_correct = at least one refusal_keyword appears and no case-specific fabrication_keyword appears. All matching is case-insensitive after stripping punctuation. The fabrication guard is a lexical heuristic for refusal-plus-invention; it does not replace manual audit of unanswerable cases.

comparability_notes.fairness: Full and No-Links use the same model, dataset, temperature, top-k, max-steps, answer rules, citation rules, action parser, and frozen score_answer implementation.
comparability_notes.difference: Only follow_links availability and its necessary prompt/action guard differ.
comparability_notes.failure_handling: Protocol, model, insufficient-evidence, disabled-tool, and budget outcomes are retained; no successful-only filtering.
comparability_notes.steps_definition: steps are agent action iterations. follow_links_calls counts executed follow_links actions; follow_links_attempts also counts disabled attempts.
